eval (() => {   const el = document.getElementById('name-404-not-found') || document.getElementById('status.404');   if (!el) return 'Not found';   // Let's find the closest heading or section   const heading = el.closest('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6');   if (heading) return heading.innerText;   // If el itself is a heading or inside one, let's find the header text or surrounding content   return el.innerText || el.outerHTML; })()
